messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — launching a BYOK + SAML sandbox for Marketplace validation. Need SI partner access and security signoff this week. @Priya can you own test plan? :calendar:

Priya Nair: Yep. I'll draft test matrix. Suggest focus: SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta sync, KMS unwrap/rotate, secrets push failure modes.

Javier Torres: Also confirm HSM vendor certs for signing keys. Which HSM vendor are we using for the BYOK pilot? SaaS-SI-Partner-Rep said 'FortiHSM' in call.

SaaS-SI-Partner-Rep: Correct — FortiHSM v2.1 prototype. We can provide remote test token and sample PKCS#11 endpoint. Need a test cert chain from Redwood.

Alex Chen: OK. SecurityBot, please add 'BYOK sandbox' to compliance tracker and note encryption at rest config.

SecurityBot: Added. Item ID: C-8276. Pending: audit logs + key custody policy.

Maya Patel: Timeline check — partner wants to demo to joint customers on Tues 10/18. Can we make sandbox stable by Fri 10/14?

Owen Li: Depends on infra quota. Need reserved GPU/VM for private VPC test cluster. Eng-infra, can we spin up 2x m5.large and 1x hsm-proxy? @Javier

Javier Torres: I'll file infra request now. Also need to setup SAML metadata endpoint. Alex, can you send SP metadata? Example below.

Alex Chen: Here's a minimal SP metadata snippet for the partner to consume:

```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://marketplace.redwood.ai/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate>MIIB...AB</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Priya Nair: For SCIM, we'll do incremental sync (delta tokens). Basic create user test:

```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"userName":"test+partner@example.com","schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"]}'
```

Priya Nair: Also capture rotation test: instruct partner to rotate key in HSM and verify old tokens invalidated.

SaaS-SI-Partner-Rep: We'll provide rotation script and a short runbook. Also need a merchant market listing stub for compliance fields — contact for PR?

Alex Chen: Marketing lead is Maya — cc'd. We need embargo window tight: hold announcement until both signoffs and legal OK. Proposed window: 10/20 announcement, but only if tests pass by 10/14.

Maya Patel: Noted. I'll block 10/15 for press review and legal. Can we get a short demo recording by 10/16?

Owen Li: Quick note: If SCIM rate limits breach, fallback is queuing with exponential backoff. Add to test cases.

Priya Nair: Adding to matrix. I'll post the matrix link when ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/partnerships/byok-sandbox-test-matrix (draft).

Alex Chen: Great. Next steps: Priya produce matrix by EOD tomorrow; Javier file infra ticket; Partner rep share PKCS#11 endpoint + rotation script; SecurityBot track C-8276. We'll do sync Thurs 9am PT.

SaaS-SI-Partner-Rep: Confirmed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
